report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations, p95 ~98ms, and zero 502s; logs and traces show healthy downstream calls. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). The alert lacks a stated threshold, so no bounded fault can be established; hand off for baseline/SLO context.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to judge whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Metrics over a longer window to detect latency trend or saturation
Downstream service (order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres) latency metrics to localize any slowdown
Error-rate or 5xx evidence; current data shows only 200s and zero 502s
